I uploaded my chat with my ex to prove he was the problem. The report's title: "Paula, you are the villain (80% confirmed)"…

I was so sure.
Callum was distant. Boring. Checked out.
That's the story I told everyone.

So I exported our WhatsApp chat and uploaded it on whatbrandonthinks.com.
Brandon is an AI that reads every message and tells you what he really thinks.
I wanted backup.

I did not get backup.

2,140 messages. 224 days.
His median reply: 4 minutes.
Mine: 4 hours 12 minutes.
My reply time in the running club group chat? 6 minutes. 💀

He said "I miss you" 14 times.
I said it twice.

"When'd you last tell her something you noticed? Not 'love you.' Anybody can say love you. Something only she does."

If you don't have an answer, it doesn't make you a bad husband. After enough years, the things she does every day just turn into background.

You've noticed them. You've just never said them.

So let a song say it. Answer a few questions about her, and we'll turn what you've noticed into a song with her name in it.
